summary: ENHANCED RECOVERY TECHNOLOGIES AS (org. no. 816 003 202) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2015-09-30. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 72.100 (Forskning og eksperimentell utvikling innenfor naturvitenskap og teknikk). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 5.3 m and net income was NOK 569 560. Board chair: Robert Storbekk.
